title: The Shocking Truth About Weed Killer (Glyphosate) in Your Food! | Dr. Steven Gundry
summary: Dr. Gundry claims glyphosate residues are everywhere in food and harm the gut, mitochondria and cancer risk, and urges organic food and glycine.

assertions.quote: Glyphosate now is known to independently cause leaky gut without any other reason.
glyphosate preferentially kills friendly bacteria, leaving bad bacteria alive
glyphosate use increases the risk of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma by 41%
So now almost all of our conventional grain products, wheat, corn, soybeans, just to name a few, oats, are sprayed with Roundup

verdicts.note: Pre-harvest desiccation is used on a minority of US wheat and on oats mainly in Canada, not on most corn or soy.

assertions.quote: So we now have super weeds that actually have to have more glyphosate poured on them.
just because it says non-GMO means absolutely nothing about the presence of glyphosate
you're much safer looking for organic on the label
just get some glycine in your diet and prevent glyphosate from substituting for glycine

verdicts.note: There is no human evidence that supplemental glycine blocks glyphosate uptake or effects.
